title: Burlington Police lieutenant charged with assaulting family member
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Crime Lieutenant Peter Abaskharoun was placed on paid administrative leave A Burlington Police lieutenant was charged with assault and battery on a family member and intimidation of a witness after he allegedly headbutted his wife during an argument early Sunday morning, court records show.
Peter Abaskharoun , 46, of Burlington, pleaded not guilty to both counts during his arraignment at Woburn District Court Monday.
A bail commissioner set his bail at $2,500, and Abaskharoun was released after a six-hour hold, according to a Burlington police report.

title: Dennis DPW worker identified as a victim in N.H. motorcycle crash that killed 3
author: Brendan Nordstrom
bullets: Local News Cameron Mosher previously worked as a call firefighter in town The Town of Dennis identified one of the three victims killed in a Saturday evening motorcycle collision as six-year Department of Public Works employee Cameron “Cam” Mosher.

Mosher, 28, of Dennis, who previously worked as a call firefighter with the Dennis Fire Department, is the son of Dennis firefighter Robert “Bert” Mosher, according to statements released by the town and the firefighters union.
“Our thoughts are with the Mosher family and our Department of Public Works colleagues and friends during this incredibly difficult time,” the town wrote in the statement.
